newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.47 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 4.47 percent at a tender on Tuesday, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.52885 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.56 percent at last week's tender of the quarterly bills.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue were HK$10.66 billion against HK$6.43 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
